subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a public reasoning display-format config contract, and if so should precedence be channel/account-first, agent/global-first, or Telegram-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public config surface and crosses shared agent delivery plus channel rendering policy, so code inspection cannot choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Define Shared Contract
options.body: Add a small supported display-format enum with explicit precedence, keep italic as default, and cover shared agent plus Telegram paths.

options.title: Limit To Telegram Plugin
options.body: Keep the new choice under Telegram channel or account config only, reducing global API surface but leaving other channels without the same contract.

options.title: Defer To Existing Formatting Work
options.body: Leave this issue open or close later only if maintainers decide Telegram rich/parse-mode settings are the intended replacement for reasoning-specific formatting.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Add a small supported display-format enum with explicit precedence, keep italic as default, and cover shared agent plus Telegram paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior review and current-code history for the reasoning-format/product contract choice.
